inv.desc_en:
REF: 7936790

Inmo Olaya offers the opportunity to acquire a restaurant transfer in Barcelona, a prestigious designer venue in a Prime Zone, located in one of the most exclusive areas of Sant Gervasi, Barcelona. This designer establishment, with a capacity for 76 diners, enjoys high revenue and an excellent reputation.

Key Features:

Premium Location: In the heart of Sant Gervasi, surrounded by a sophisticated environment and a high-density population with high purchasing power.
Exclusive Design: An elegant and modern space, with decor cared for in every detail that creates a unique and welcoming atmosphere.
High Revenue: Demonstrable sales history, with a loyal and constantly growing clientele.
Capacity for 76 People: Spacious 50m2 dining room plus a 20m2 indoor terrace and a 2-table outdoor terrace.
Equipped Kitchen: Complete and functional facilities, ready to continue operating successfully.
Adapted Bathroom: Accessible for people with reduced mobility, complying with all regulations.
Competitive Rent: Advantageous rental conditions for €6,300 per month.
Transfer fee of €315,000

Investors looking for a consolidated and profitable business in a high-value area.
Experienced gastronomes who wish to continue the success of this project.
Entrepreneurs who want to develop their own gastronomic concept in a privileged setting.
Do not miss this opportunity to acquire a turnkey business in one of the most sought-after areas of Barcelona.

Contact us for more information!
